text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day halfway through summer training camp.
Bubble Gum Fellow had taken on coaching at Air Groove's request.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looking good! Your form hasn't broken down either.
Shall we try picking up the pace even more next?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If this were a GⅠ-level race...
that wouldn't have been enough to take the lead yet.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ngh......
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you really have gotten faster!
No wonder Air Groove has such high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sure... that wasn't your limit yet.
I wonder... what I have to do to make you show me what lies beyond that?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: If I can elevate her all-out power even further with my know-how... she'll truly be a rival worth competing against!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Enjoying the process of identifying and nurturing talent while still planning to compete against it. How very like her.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And, as for the other person... let's see—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —You want *me* to coach Suzuka and Windy?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. The meeting for the event is taking
longer than anticipated, so my hands are tied.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Suzuka is a bundle of talent. I'd like to use this chance to develop Windy's explosive power too. Can I count on you?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see. Of course I don't mind!
If you're paying this much attention to it... it must be interesting♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My thanks. However, Suzuka aside,
Windy is currently in a bit of a difficult state—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo waaaaayyy!!
Windy-chan wants to play moreee!!
choice_data_list: ...Looks like you've been feeling stressed out.
...Looks like you've been feeling stressed out.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, first we'll have to
get Windy motivated, huh.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And somehow, draw out Suzuka's full power. ...Nice, this is starting to get fun!
choice_data_list: So what are we going to do about your training?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"See, that'll be solved as long as the three of us
can just train at the same time."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Well, just watch me.
I'm sure it'll work out somehow!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All right! In that case, for the beach flags showdown,
first up is me and Suzuka. Ready――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: LET'S GO!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, close one, close one!
I'm not losing to my juniors just yet!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hmph!
Something like that is bound to be boring, nod-da.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah, the wind is a bit strong today, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Keep an eye on the finish flag so it doesn't move, okay? Because if it moves, we'll be in huuuuge trouble!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
!? ...Fufufu.
I just had a wonderful idea!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like Windy is resting,
so round two of me versus Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Time to GO!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwa-ha-ha-ha! The finish flag
belongs to Windy-chan now!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...A-Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's not looking good, huh.
The finish line just ran away, after all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure about this, Suzuka?
Letting them take the lead, that is."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, both of you are finally getting serious.
Yes, yes, this just got a whole lot more fun!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...See?
Everything worked out, didn't it?
choice_data_list: You're really good at carrying people!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Oops, I'd better give chase too... right!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Even against Senpai... I won't give up the lead...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Catch me if you can, I say--!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, both of you are pretty good!
I'll have to get serious too... right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bubble skillfully brought out their true potential while conducting a thoroughly rewarding training session...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I think that was good training.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmm~? So what are we doing next~?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hmm... They just went all-out in a sprint, after all. Given their stamina, maybe we should switch directions.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Is there something fun we can do at the beach other than running...
Got any ideas, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Put on the spot to brainstorm, I frantically think.
Trainings we can do on the summer beachâ
choice_data_list: Maybe we could do some meditation at the beach or something?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Sumo!? Ahaha! I like that idea.
Now we just need to give it a summer twist."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You've gotta be kidding me...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Unstable footing is ideal for training the lower body and core.
A floating marine battle royale—clever idea.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! I'll take you both down together!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Prepare yourself!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All right, bring it on!
I'll take you on!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Could that be Bubble and the others?
Fufu, it's nice and lively, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Joining in is the only option here.
Come on, let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Others gathered around for the ocean battle royale,
making this amusing training session lively and energetic.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see... Forging the spirit, I like it!
In that case, I might have just the thing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Aargh! It cracked again!
This die-cut candy is rigged!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Is it okay... to shave this part off...?
choice_data_list: You can't be too bold or too cautious.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Right, balance is everything in all things.
After that, it's just about having the perseverance to maintain it... there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bubble-senpai is incredible... She's already almost done.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I don't cut corners, whether it's playing around or training.
And done! First in line for the shaved ice reward!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: Oh? Bubble-chan, you're playing a pretty nostalgic game there.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Shall we give it a try as well?
Naturally, we'll take the reward sweets as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "mental training"—or rather, the sweets-scramble die-cut candy contest—turned out to be a massive hit.
